notes.title: Quest confusion early in the game - FIXED
notes.content:
Error that a later mission was appearing early in the game. This has now been fixed. Sorry guys!

The mission for saving Kenix from the Dog Tower is much later in the game but appeared in the early Quests when you just start. This has been now resolved. As always I will keep replaying my game and looking out making bugs and fixes when I find them.

notes.title: Multiple bugs fixed!
notes.content:
As my ongoing commitment into making this game as best as we can we regularly play through this game and work on fixing annoying bugs as well as adding improvements. 

Here is the list of improvements. 

1. Special gun and binoculars now findable in later levels 
2. Some items were key items but cluttered up the common items area. This has been fixed.
3. Certain bosses were quite weak when powered up. Still working on this but some of these are now done. Expect more to be improved later. This is true mainly for the side quests.
4. Saving Amelia's boyfriend side quest would not disappear after completed. It now does!
5. Some items were free! This has been fixed. Sakura would never give you something free!
6. Divine cat blessing fixed (to not ruin the game for people not that far I won't say more!)
7. Cats appearing before rescued bug is now fixed. (again not turning this into a spoiler!)
8. Tucker's text had some typos these are fixed now

Thank you ALL for playing Kenix and the Cat King! We will be continuing to improve this game regularly until it reaches perfection! 

If you find any bugs while playing the game please contact us and we will fix it right away!

Sending out the love to all you cat fans for supporting Kenix and the Cat King!

Kenix and Merrifield Publishers Ltd

notes.title: IN GAME ACHIEVEMENTS NOW ADDED!!!
notes.content:
[b]IN GAME ACHIEVEMENTS ADDED!!![/b]

NOTE: These are not Steam achievements so will only appear in game

If you have been playing this game and have performed actions that should result in achievements do not worry this will update and add your achievements!

The achievements area is in the menu screen. There are 64 achievements that are possible. 

My favourite achievement to get is just sleeping everywhere (well the Cat King is a cat of course!) 

Most additional battles and items you collect will be achievements
